description: Opens a local document from a chat link in its Mac app, and a folder link in Finder, with one click. Text and code files keep BB's preview, and Option-click selects any linked item in Finder. Scripts, apps and unknown file types are only selected, never opened, including when a link hides them behind a symlink. A bundled skill tells agents to write local paths as clickable links. Works in the macOS desktop app on the Mac that runs BB.
